title: An agy and Pi live account check runs with a writable account home and scratch directory and reports a login verdict
description: On a running test install, an agy account with a read-only account home and a colliding fixed /tmp smoke path still gets a writable account home and scratch directory and records a login verdict in master status rather than a check environment fault.

steps.name: agy account check shows a login verdict in master status on a running test install
